section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the main analyses of a single study examining associations between body image variables, sexual health indicators, and age. Pearson correlations (Table 2) revealed that body appreciation was negatively correlated with BMI (r = -.39, p < .01) and positively associated with sexual satisfaction, while appearance dissatisfaction was negatively related to sexual health outcomes. Hierarchical regression analyses demonstrated that body appreciation predicted unique variance in sexual function, satisfaction, and distress beyond BMI and appearance dissatisfaction, and moderation analyses revealed that body appreciation moderated the relationship between age and sexual satisfaction, particularly among women with significant sexual function difficulties.

Hierarchical regression analyses demonstrated that body appreciation predicted unique variance in sexual function, satisfaction, and distress beyond BMI and appearance dissatisfaction. Moderation analyses revealed that body appreciation significantly moderated the relationship between age and sexual satisfaction, particularly among women with significant sexual function difficulties.
